facts.text: UW-Superior offers Nonresident Tuition Waiver awards that can reduce nonresident tuition by nearly 50% for qualifying students from outside Wisconsin or Minnesota.

sources.title: Tuition Award & Reciprocity Programs - UW-Superior
sources.quote: Living outside Wisconsin or Minnesota? The NTW Award can reduce your nonresident tuition by nearly 50% — automatically considered after admission based on academic merit and/or financial need.
